question: Should OpenClaw adopt the narrow `openclaw commands list/inspect` catalog, and which schema fields and registry relationships should become stable in v1?
rationale: The RFC deliberately leaves durable public-contract choices unresolved, and repository policy requires maintainer discussion before acceptance.

options.title: Sponsor narrow catalog
options.body: Create the discussion, endorse Option A, and define only the minimum stable v1 fields and registry ownership rules.

options.title: Adopt broader catalog
options.body: Choose Option B and explicitly accept the larger operational and compatibility surface.

options.title: Decline a unified catalog
options.body: Keep command discovery split across existing CLI, Gateway, plugin, and node surfaces.

recommendation.title: Sponsor narrow catalog
recommendation.body: Create the discussion, endorse Option A, and define only the minimum stable v1 fields and registry ownership rules.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the active RFC acceptance process and are the strongest repository-history owner for the required lifecycle decision.
